definitions.explanation: describes institutions established and operated by government entities (national, prefectural, or municipal)

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{公立|こうりつ}{高校|こうこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: My son attends a public high school.

examples.japanese: {公立|こうりつ}の{病院|びょういん}は{私立|しりつ}より{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Public hospitals are cheaper than private ones.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}には{公立|こうりつ}{図書館|としょかん}が{三|みっ}つある。
examples.english: There are three public libraries in this area.

notes:
USAGE:
- {公立|こうりつ}の〜 (public ~)
- {公立|こうりつ}{学校|がっこう} (public school)
- {公立|こうりつ}{病院|びょういん} (public hospital)

RELATED TERMS:
- {私立|しりつ} (private - antonym)
- {国立|こくりつ} (national, government-operated)
- {市立|しりつ}/{市立|いちりつ} (municipal, city-operated)
- {県立|けんりつ} (prefectural)

NOTE ON READINGS:
Be careful with {市立|しりつ} vs {私立|しりつ} - both have the same reading. In speech, {私立|しりつ} is sometimes pronounced {私立|わたくしりつ} to distinguish it.
